notes: TBox expansion, paired with geography-replace-0019. Keeps the revision's relation (formed_by) and new object (an earthquake) and gives them to a made-up class (the skelloth, a newly described kind of coastal rock pillar) under the real class of coastal rock pillars, so no old value is pushed out and the real sea-stack rule is untouched. The derived queries name invented pillars (Grey Orrin, the Hollow Thane, Mervane's Needle) with the class stated in the prompt (inheritance, 2 hops, bridge in the prompt): the inserted rule is their only route. The third is an application (a guidebook writer's description). Near unrelated: the origin of the real Twelve Apostles, which must stay erosion by the waves (a bare 'coastal pillar -> earthquake' mapping would leak there). Names are invented; the counting step records that they are absent from the corpus. Side facts and checks are those of the paired revision.
